source.author: verg
source.text: Tum senior Nautes, unum Tritonia Pallas quem docuit multaque insignem reddidit arte, haec responsa dabat, vel quae portenderet ira magna deum, vel quae fatorum posceret ordo; isque his Aenean solatus vocibus infit:
source.text_original: Tum senior Nautes, unum Tritonia Pallas / quem docuit multaque insignem reddidit arte, / haec responsa dabat, vel quae portenderet ira / magna deum, vel quae fatorum posceret ordo; / isque his Aenean solatus vocibus infit: /
source.text_english: Then the elder Nautes, the one whom Tritonian Pallas had taught and had made distinguished by many a skill, was giving these responses, whether the great anger of the gods was foreshadowing them, or whether the order of fate was demanding them; and with these words he began to comfort Aeneas:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in moenia pernix Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_original: in moenia pernix / Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_english: Swift Thespia flies down to the walls, and Tritonia to dear Argus.
